item.name: Unbound
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: The rarest chase trait, built around a massive damage boost with small SPA and range bonuses for a long-term carry unit.

item.name: Primordial
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A well-rounded mythic roll that stacks damage, attack speed, and range for flexible main damage dealers.

item.name: Forsaken
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A mythic crit-focused trait that raises both critical chance and critical damage, plus a small range boost.

item.name: Draconic
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A mythic specialist roll for DoT units, adding damage-over-time power, a solid DMG boost, and lower unit cost.

item.name: Investor
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: The economy trait for farm units, raising income so the rest of the team can scale faster.

item.name: Optics
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A rare pure-range roll for units that need more coverage on wide maps or awkward placement spots.

item.name: Bolt
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A rare attack-speed trait that lowers SPA so the unit attacks more often and keeps effects up longer.

item.name: Precision 2
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A rare crit upgrade with stronger critical chance and damage than Precision 1 for crit-scaling kits.

item.name: Limit Breaker
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: An uncommon single-stat damage roll and a solid early stop when higher multi-bonus traits are still out of reach.

item.name: Precision 1
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: An uncommon starter crit trait that adds modest critical chance and damage before Precision 2 or Forsaken.

item.name: Range 2
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: An uncommon range upgrade over Range 1 for units that just need a bit more reach.

item.name: Speed 2
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: An uncommon SPA reduction that helps attack tempo until a stronger speed trait like Bolt or Primordial lands.

item.name: Strength 2
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: An uncommon damage roll that beats Strength 1 and works as a temporary DPS stop.

item.name: Enlightenment
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A common leveling trait that speeds up EXP gain while a unit is still catching up, then should be replaced later.

item.name: Range 1
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A common early range placeholder that only slightly extends attack reach until a better trait appears.

item.name: Speed 1
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: A common early SPA reduction that is fine to keep only until a stronger attack-speed trait lands.

item.name: Strength 1
item.acquisitionNote: Reroll with 1 Trait Crystal at the Trait Reroll stand between Crafting and Evolving in the lobby upgrade zone.
item.cardSummary: The most common damage roll, offering a small DMG boost and little reason to keep it past the early game.
